## Developer Guide

If you are new to using `nbdev` here are some useful pointers to get you
started.

### Install epub_explorer in Development mode

``` sh
# make sure epub_explorer package is installed in development mode
$ pip install -e .

# make changes under nbs/ directory
# ...

# compile to have changes apply to epub_explorer
$ nbdev_prepare
```

## Usage

### Installation

Install latest from the GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/kafkasl/epub-explorer):

``` sh
$ pip install git+https://github.com/kafkasl/epub-explorer.git
```

or from [conda](https://anaconda.org/kafkasl/epub-explorer)

``` sh
$ conda install -c kafkasl epub_explorer
```

or from [pypi](https://pypi.org/project/epub-explorer/)

``` sh
$ pip install epub_explorer
```

### Documentation

Documentation can be found hosted on this GitHub
[repository](https://github.com/kafkasl/epub-explorer)’s
[pages](https://kafkasl.github.io/epub-explorer/). Additionally you can
find package manager specific guidelines on
[conda](https://anaconda.org/kafkasl/epub-explorer) and
[pypi](https://pypi.org/project/epub-explorer/) respectively.
